npc_text: Whoa ho ho! Maybe you really ARE creative! Origami... Don't suppose you'd trade some Scraps for it...?
Notes: defaut first character wanting to buy your first drawing.

npc_text: Looking fantastic! Do you not know about  Scraps!? Pastels and paste...
Every bit of creativity takes something from the world and makes it into something new. One Ittle Scrap is another Ittle masterpiece, am I right?
Notes: Will need character Character explains scrap and tells you that what you make you can place in the world.

npc_text: Anything you create can be added into the world with a little Scrap. Here, I'll give you some of mine. Make  some art and put it into the world!
Say, that's looking better already! But, y'know, sometimes it matters just as much what's there as what's not there, am I right?
See this? I call it a scrubber rubber. You can make pictures by getting rid of what's already there. Try for yourself and make some little spikies!
An eraser? Doesn't really have that ring to it, but you do you. At least y'know how to use it.
Notes: Need to add reward for new tools, also need call out that you get things

npc_text: Y'know, none of my friends really believe in human creativity. But here you are! I gotta show you off.
Notes: Note could use like a little ? ! or indicator to talk to them again

npc_text: I've asked some of them to stop by. Think you could make me, er, us look good?
